name: Leap-year date bug
prompt: The file solution.py contains a `days_between(date1, date2)` function that miscounts days whenever the range crosses February in a leap year, because it always treats February as having 28 days. Fix it to correctly account for leap years (a year is a leap year if divisible by 4, except century years not divisible by 400). Return the FULL corrected contents of solution.py and nothing else — no explanation, no markdown fences.
